description: This file contains functions for normalizing, resolving, comparing, and merging session identity objects related to an ACP runtime, including handling session IDs and states.

methods.name: normalizeText
methods.description: Trims a string value or returns undefined if not a string.

methods.name: normalizeIdentityState
methods.description: Normalizes the identity state to 'pending' or 'resolved'.

methods.name: normalizeIdentitySource
methods.description: Normalizes the identity source to 'ensure', 'status', or 'event'.

methods.name: normalizeIdentity
methods.description: Normalizes a SessionAcpIdentity object, ensuring valid fields and default values.

methods.name: resolveSessionIdentityFromMeta
methods.description: Extracts and normalizes session identity from metadata.

methods.name: identityHasStableSessionId
methods.description: Checks if the identity has a stable session ID.

methods.name: resolveRuntimeResumeSessionId
methods.description: Resolves the session ID used to resume a runtime session.

methods.name: isSessionIdentityPending
methods.description: Determines if a session identity is pending.

methods.name: identityEquals
methods.description: Checks if two session identities are equivalent.

methods.name: mergeSessionIdentity
methods.description: Merges two session identities, prioritizing the incoming identity based on resolution state.

methods.name: createIdentityFromEnsure
methods.description: Creates a session identity with 'pending' state from a handle, typically for ensuring session existence.

methods.name: createIdentityFromStatus
methods.description: Creates a session identity based on runtime status information.

methods.name: resolveRuntimeHandleIdentifiersFromIdentity
methods.description: Extracts backend and agent session IDs from a session identity.
